To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the ESR spectra in BF3-etharate solution of the copper(II)complexes of 5-oxygencrown ethers revealed a typical g anisotropy ascribable to a 3dz2-type complex, and the axial ligation by water molecules was confirmed by the observation of the superhyperfine splitting due to 17o isotope, and the coordination geometries of the complexes were proposed.
the 3dz 2 type copper( II) complex with axial water molecules is formed from the copper(II) ion and 5-oxygen donor ligand in the presence of water in BF3- etherate solution.
the 5-oxygen donor crown ethers form the 3dz 2 type copper( II) complex with axially coordinated water molecules in the presence of the optimal amount of water.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the ESR study of a new 3dz2-type copper(II) - crown ether complex with axially coordinated water molecules.
the preparation and characterization of new copper(II)-crown ethers with 5-oxygen donor atoms.
the synthesis and characterization of a new 3dz2-type copper(II)-crown ether complex with axially coordinated water molecules.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the complex is a 3dz2-type copper(II) ion, which is coordinated by two 5-oxygen atoms of crown ether and by two water molecules in an octahedral geometry, and that the water molecule is coordinated to the copper(II) center in the axial position.
the copper(II) ion in the complex is axially ligated by the 5-oxygen donor and the water molecule, and the 3dz 2 type copper( II) complex was formed.
the complex has a distorted square pyramidal structure with the axial ligation by water molecule.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the 5-oxygen donor ligand, 1,4,7,10-tetraoxacyclododecane (dodecane-1,4,10,7-tetraoxide) is a new type of 3dz2 complex ligand.
the 3dz 2 type copper( II) complex was obtained in the BF3-ether system, and the axial ligation was realized in the presence of water.
the 3dz 2 type copper(Ⅱ) complexes with axial ligands are formed from the complexes having 4 or 6 oxygen donor sites in the presence of water.
The main takeaway from our work is that

we have been able to demonstrate that it is possible to use a combination of ESR spectroscopy and quantum mechanical calculations to obtain information about the geometry and electronic structure of a copper(II) ion in a complex.
the coordination of the 5-membered ring of crown ether with a Cu(II) ion is not as strong as that of a 6-membered ring of 18-crown-6 ether.

the 5-oxygen donor ligands are not always able to coordinate copper(II) ion in a square planar fashion, but they are also able to form a 3dz2-type copper(II)complex in a similar manner as the 4-oxygen donors.
